record.reason: Although the model uses 1.3B active parameters out of 6.9B total and discusses compute per forward pass, the stated contribution is an open MoE model and extensive MoE training experiments. The paper's conclusion centers on releasing model/data/code and training analyses, not an inference-reduction method.
